items.q: What should you remember about **Dual fuel**?
items.a: **glucose (glycolysis) + glutamine (glutaminolysis);** must restrict both; ketones feed healthy cells, not corrupted tumor mitochondria.
**built after Trudy Dupont** brainstem-tumor case (~10+ years); ratio tool for prevention and management.

items.q: What should you remember about **Not "cure" language**?
items.a: **manage, extend life, make tumors** indolent; glioblastoma still deadly but metabolic results claimed vs 100-year stagnation.

items.q: What should you remember about **Lifestyle prescription**?
items.a: **cut ultraprocessed carbs, move, sleep,** lower emotional stress; individualize macros for GKI; avoid HFCS; seed oils secondary/uncertain.

items.q: What should you remember about **Carcinogens converge**?
items.a: **forever chemicals, microplastics, arsenic/cadmium** in water → OXPHOS damage → fermentation shift.

items.a: **population demand + published case** reports will shift oncology; foundation support asked for metabolic research.
